_comment_: v3 (2026-09-22): v3: 128 x 128 x 64 cells at dx=dy=10 m, dz=1 m (1280 x 1280 x 64 m), stored uncropped; training takes random 64 x 64 x 32 windows (z offset 1-31 so the engine's floor and roof, where the level ladder is anchored, never coincide with a window edge). Channel depth 3-16 m log-uniform, levels from a sampled aggradation ratio. Previous: v2: same as v1 plus n_sources, the number of entry points on the upstream edge (1, 1, 2 or 3: half the reservoirs a single valley outlet, the rest two or three coeval belts entering at different positions, all with the reservoir azimuth). Needs the ResMill commit that adds n_sources. CB_LABYRINTH (Pyrcz 2004) — connected-but-jigsaw labyrinthine channel-belt architecture; medium NTG, low-sinuosity channels with rare avulsion, prominent abandoned-mud plugs giving the labyrinth signature. See header of config_full_pv_shoestring.json for the comment-tag convention used here ('skip — preset default' / 'skip — class default' / 'VARIED').

grid._comment_dx_: v3: 128 x 128 x 64 cells at dx=dy=10 m, dz=1 m (1280 x 1280 x 64 m), stored uncropped; training takes random 64 x 64 x 32 windows (z offset 1-31 so the engine's floor and roof, where the level ladder is anchored, never coincide with a window edge). dx=dy=10m, dz=1m. CB-labyrinth channels are ~64m wide -> 6-7 cells. Migration step ~25m -> 2.5 cells/event.

preset._comment_: Pyrcz 2004 labyrinthine architecture. Locks rest of kwargs to CB_LABYRINTH baseline unless overridden below.

NTGtarget._comment_: VARIED. CB-labyrinth NTG range — medium NTG, baseline 0.25.

mCHsinu._comment_: VARIED. Mean sinuosity. Baseline 1.3 (low — that's the labyrinth signature: jigsaw-like compartments).

mCHwdratio._comment_: VARIED. CB-labyrinth W:D. Wider than PV but still bounded by labyrinth signature.

mCHdepth._comment_: VARIED. Channel depth (m), log-uniform so 3-8 m stays as common as 8-16 m; 16 m = half the column, two levels at least.

probAvulInside._comment_: VARIED. Low in-belt avulsion is the labyrinth signature (channels stay connected). Baseline 0.05.

mFFCHprop._comment_: VARIED. Abandoned-channel mud-plug fraction. Widened to [0.1, 0.55] for visual variability.

mdistMigrate._comment_: VARIED. Migration distance per event. Baseline 25.

azimuth._comment_: VARIED. Flow direction (deg, clockwise from +x). Channels are not 180-symmetric so the full circle matters.

nlevel._comment_: AUTO. Aggradation ratio r = level spacing / channel depth, uniform 0.7-1.4 per reservoir; nlevel = round((64 - depth) / (r * depth)) + 1 so the levels span the whole 64 m column: r < 1 stacked channels cut into each other, r > 1 floodplain between levels, never more than 0.4 depth.

ntime._comment_: v3: 75 events per level in the 800 x 800 m box, x2.56 (plan area) for 1280 x 1280 m. ntime is a cap: a level stops as soon as it has its NTG share, so only high-NTG rows use the extra events. Measured 2026-09-22: with the old cap SH_DIST delivered 0.73 of target, x1.6 0.82, x2.56 0.88.

ntime_per_level._comment_: TRUE so every level gets its own event budget (independent of how many lower levels consumed). Without this, deep levels starve when NTGtarget=0.99 stops never firing.

probAvulOutside._comment_: VARIED (v1 fixed it at 0.05). Probability per event that a fresh river enters from the boundary; times ntime this is the number of fresh entries per level, spread over the n_sources valleys.

stdevCHsinu._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.15 -> 0.1 (tighter sinuosity distribution).

stdevCHwdratio._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 1.0 -> 2.0.

stdevdistMigrate._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 10 -> 8.

stdevCHsource._comment_: VARIED (v3). Across-flow scatter (std, m) of the entry point of every channel drawn from the pool; 80.0 m fixed in v2 = nodal entry. 5 m keeps that, 300 m spreads entries over the whole 1280 m edge.

mLVdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 1.0 -> 0.5.

stdevLVdepth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.2 -> 0.1.

mLVwidth._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 40 -> 30.

mLVheight._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.5 -> 0.3.

mCSnum._comment_: splays disabled — adds visual complexity without diagnostic value; future versions can re-enable.

stdevFFCHprop._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.0 -> 0.15.

mNeckFFCHprop._comment_: skip — preset default (also class default). Neck-cutoff oxbow mud plug only useful for MEANDER_OXBOW.

Cf._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 0.0078 -> 0.0036.

scour_factor._comment_: skip — preset default. Override of class 2.0 -> 10.0.

n_sources._comment_: VARIED. Entry points on the upstream edge; sources at least 15% of the edge apart.

poro_noise_std._comment_: VARIED (v3). Relative std of a correlated porosity texture inside sand cells; perm follows via the K-C slope. 0 = smooth ramp (v1/v2).

poro_noise_range._comment_: VARIED (v3). Lateral correlation length of that texture in cells (20-80 m); vertical is a third.
